text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin's signature racewear has arrived. Her cool, street-style outfit does a great job of accentuating her natural sharpness.
choice_data_list: Good thing you let them know what kind of design you wanted.
Good thing you let them know what kind of design you wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, duh. It's not like I'd wear clothes that don't look good on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And I still feel the same since that time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin, Taishin, Taishiiin! Is it true you're getting your own signature racewear?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All your hard work's paying off! I'm so happy for youuu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, can it! I told you guys not to yell!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Well, this is cause for celebration. Such high emotions are only to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What kind of design do you have in mind for it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I looked through some magazines, and it seems that these are popular lately.
The page she shows us features bright, eye-catching costumes and cute garments that would be perfect for concert performances.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I hate all of those. They're not my style.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Forget those. I want something more like what I usually wear.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But it's your signature racewear! Are you sure you don't want something really awesome with a lotta oomph?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna wear anything gaudy or be some loser who has to depend on her racewear to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm good enough as I am, and I don't need anything other than my own strength to be a better racer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see. And you want your signature racewear to reflect that, yes? I quite like that logic, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I sorta got caught up in the moment and exaggerated a little, but none of what I said was a lie.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna cater to anyone, nor am I gonna rely on some fabric… I'll win my races all on my own!
choice_data_list: You can lean on me, though.
You can lean on me, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna cater to anyone, nor am I gonna rely on some fabric… I'll win my races all on my own!
choice_data_list: You can lean on me, though.
You can lean on me, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Thanks, Captain Obvious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I've finally reached a point where people's eyes are on me…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna keep rising up to the very peak of the Twinkle Series!
choice_data_list: Yeah! And I'll be with you all the way!
Yeah! And I'll be with you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Um, don't get ahead of yourself.
Since Narita Taishin wants to run and it's the perfect chance to break in her outfit, we head over to the training track.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Taishin sure is amazing today, isn't she? It's like her signature racewear boosted her intensity or something.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's impossible to tear my eyes away from her!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That so?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Good! I'll steal everyone's attention and devour them whole!)
And so, the starting shot signaling Narita Taishin's resurgence blazes into the sky with a roaring bang.
I tell Narita Taishin that trainers like myself exist to support and help her get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Urk…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I guess I will if I'm in the mood. But I'm not looking to get chummy or anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get stronger through my will alone. You support me as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's all there is to it, right?
choice_data_list: I'm fine with that. Let's get stronger—together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Yup.
She gives me a noncommittal nod… But still, she acknowledges me as her trainer, and that's good enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you grinning about? Get weird with me, and I'll kick you to the moon!
There's still a lot of work to do, and I don't necessarily have Narita Taishin's full trust yet…
But we've sworn in our hearts to keep moving forward the only way we can.
